title: Concept: Development dependency declared as a bare wildcard
description: package.json declares a `*` specifier in `devDependencies`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `*` specifier in `devDependencies`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `*` specifier in `devDependencies`.
